essential.accessibleSummary: Split bar chart showing the proportion of adults aged 16 years and over and their level of worry about the rising costs of living by their level of worry about the coronavirus (COVID-19) pandemic in Great Britain between 27 April and 22 May 2022. The chart shows that adults who were very worried about the rising costs of living were more likely to also be worried about the coronavirus pandemic.
sourceText: Office for National Statistics – Business Insights and Conditions Survey
